scenarios.name: Independent Europe
scenarios.text: Peace in Ukraine, cheap clean energy, Poland as a hub for rebuilding Ukraine.

scenarios.name: Balancing
scenarios.text: A weak but dangerous Russia, changing energy prices, nuclear power 2–4 years late.

scenarios.name: Under pressure
scenarios.text: The USA pulls back from Europe, high defence spending, a faster fall in population.

forces.name: Demographics
forces.text: In 2025 about 238 thousand children were born and about 406 thousand people died. Every year there are fewer people of working age.
forces.line: Every pair of hands will be needed more, and machines will take over some of the work.

forces.name: Ageing
forces.text: The median age will pass 50 by 2060. More people will need care and rehabilitation.
forces.line: More and more people will need treatment, rehabilitation and care.

forces.name: Energy
forces.text: The first nuclear unit is planned for 2036; grids and renewables will be built over decades.
forces.line: New power plants and grids built over decades.

forces.name: Security
forces.text: Poland becomes a NATO frontline country.
forces.line: Poland becomes a NATO frontline country.

forces.name: Automation and AI
forces.text: Fewer people to work means more machines and software.
forces.line: Less routine work, more work with people and with data.

shrinking: These may shrink: coal, routine office work, new building outside big cities.
